evidence.quote: The International Business programme at TH Nürnberg is a seven-semester course, awarding 210 ECTS credits.
English is the primary language of instruction for the International Business programme, used exclusively in semesters one to three and predominantly thereafter.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,000 EUR

notes: Application channel unclear: the page only says 'Submit application via Please check this website.' and does not name uni-assist, VPD or a university portal, so no applicationChannel fact is given. Tuition fee of 1,000 EUR per semester is explicitly stated for applicants from non-EU countries, but the page also says 'Tuition fee exemptions apply to Students from partner universities'. English test list is partial: the quote names TOEIC, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT and IELTS Academic (plus Cambridge C1 Advanced); acceptedTests only carries codes available in the schema.

note.fr: L'admission est basée sur la moyenne finale de votre diplôme d'entrée à l'université (numerus clausus) ; vérifiez les seuils de sélection auprès de l'université.
note.en: Admission is based on the final average grade of your university entrance qualification (numerus clausus); check selection thresholds with the university.

evidence.quote: Admission is based on the final average grade of your university entrance qualification (e.g. school-leaving certificate or prior studies).
